From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Crosswalk: Launch ops & Sprint0 roster — OliveBridge pilot handoff

Team — wrapping up the sales close for OliveBridge (DEAL-7831). Quick summary and asks so CS can pick up without delay: 

Deal snapshot:
- Product: Redwood Hosted inference (dedicated pilot)
- Term: 3-month pilot (paid) starting June 1
- MRR/commitment: Pilot commitment covered under contract (see SOW attached)
- Primary contact: Samir Khan, Platform Lead (samir.khan@olivebridge.com)
- Region / constraints: US data residency required; customer prefers VPC peering + KMS integration

Committed deliverables from sales to CS:
1) Sprint0 (2 weeks) to validate infra connectivity, SSO, and config.
2) Production-like smoke tests and latency baseline.
3) Documentation handoff & runbook for go/no-go.

Known technical constraints / blockers:
- OliveBridge needs customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) and HSM-backed key wraps; we flagged this in the SOW but need CS to confirm entropy/workflow.
- They will request 3 x T4-like GPU nodes (burst capacity) during ramp. We have allocation but should confirm quota with infra.
- SSO: Okta; they asked for SCIM provisioning — need engineering touch if not standard.

Attachments: SOW_OliveBridge_v1.pdf, prod-config-questionnaire.xlsx (config questionnaire is partially filled).

Asks: 
- Please assign a primary CS owner and a technical lead.
- Confirm availability for a 60m kickoff with OliveBridge next Tuesday 31 May 15:00 PT (proposed).
- Review the questionnaire and flag any items needing pre-kickoff engineering time (network, KMS, quotas).

I'll stay on the thread through Sprint0 to help unblock approvals.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187
